title: Generative discovery of chemical reaction networks
summary: Version 2 reports NMR characterization of four isolated products, including three predicted diarylation structures; v1 contains earlier family-level MS evidence. The isolated products are supported by 1H/13C NMR; this validates structures, not every proposed reaction path, rate or barrier. The isolated-product result first appears in version 2 (2026-11-18); version 1 reported earlier family-level mass-spectrometry evidence.
